47.why: src/Stall.cpp getNoteNumberFromCv() loops for (int i = 0; i < 47; i++), so 47 is never returned and gateOuts[47] stays 0 before outputs[GATE_OUT + 47].setVoltage()

comment: The gate voltage is copied rather than thresholded, so a 5V gate arrives at the output as 5V and no range is claimed for the gate jack or the outputs. getNoteNumberFromCv() loops for (int i = 0; i < 47; i++), so index 47 is never returned: the jack printed 82 is written on every frame but only ever with 0. Its fallback, marked in the source with the comment "Wrong, but …", returns 0 for any voltage it cannot match, which makes the jack printed 35 fire for note 82 and for anything above or below the printed 35 to 82 span. The README says the module accepts notes 35 to 82; the code covers 35 to 81. Both jacks must be connected before anything is routed, because the channel loop's body is guarded by isConnected() on each.
